title: Block guest users from managing Expense Agent
summary: Guest users and external administrators can no longer enable or disable Expense Agent or schedule or stop its tasks. External users are detected from the Business Central authentication email, with the access token identity-provider claim as a fallback.
key_points: Guest and external administrator access is blocked from Expense Agent configuration changes
Detection of external users uses Business Central authentication email or identity-provider claim as fallback
Task scheduling and state changes trigger access validation before any state modification
Limited task-scheduling warning removed as users are now blocked at configuration stage
quote: Prevent guest users and external administrators from enabling or disabling Expense Agent.
